possible_causal_directions: Direction 1 (Direct Causal): support_tickets -> churn (Customers get frustrated by support process and leave)
Direction 2 (Reverse Causal): churn -> support_tickets (Customers about to leave open tickets to request refunds)
Direction 3 (Confounding Variable): customer_pain -> BOTH (Product defects cause both high tickets AND churn)
support_tickets <-> churn.data_driven_insight: Likely Direction 3: Underlying customer friction/product bugs act as a confounding variable. Support tickets are a SYMPTOM of friction, not the root cause of churn.
support_tickets <-> churn.actionable_business_decision: Do NOT attempt to reduce churn by limiting support ticket access. Instead, resolve root-cause product friction and train support teams to proactively resolve ticket issues.
